items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Last confirmed state: Tuesday 2, 12:20 p.m., on Willy’s wooden dock at the beach after his gift event. Bamboo Pole was selected in toolbar slot 8; the fishing line had been retracted and no fish was caught. A final 1.5s westward move along the dock completed without a follow-up screenshot, so exact position/time are unconfirmed. Funds were last known as 500g; energy decreased somewhat with tool use.

Farm/inventory: slots 1–5 are axe, hoe, watering can, pickaxe, scythe; slot 6 has 14 parsnip seeds; slot 8 has the received Bamboo Pole. The farmhouse parcel supplied 15 seeds and a journal entry. Exactly one parsnip is verified planted and watered in the dirt clearing south of the farmhouse. Watered soil is dark; tilled soil is brown/textured. An orange outlined square is only the targeting cursor, not proof of tilling. An adjacent weed was scythed and yielded fiber. Attempts to prepare/plant a second crop failed or were visually ambiguous; never assume a second crop exists.

Controls observed: WASD moves and can change facing; number keys select toolbar slots. Left-click uses the selected tool/item toward the pointer, with adjacent targets most reliable. X opened the parcel and mailbox when adjacent/facing correctly and advances dialogue; X did not close Willy’s letter, but Escape did. M toggles the map. Mailbox interaction failed while facing down, then worked after tapping W to face upward. C retracted an active fishing line; its general tool-use reliability remains unclear. During cutscenes, waiting advanced animations and X advanced dialogue.

Fishing observed: selecting slot 8 and left-clicking nearby ocean water cast a bobber successfully. Repeated waits produced no exclamation-mark bite alert; ripples eventually appeared around the bobber, but their meaning was unconfirmed. Pressing C then retracted the line without a catch or minigame. Bite recognition and reeling/catching mechanics remain unresolved.

Navigation: Research Farm is west of town. The farmhouse’s southern doorway leads to a porch whose side railings block movement; use the central staircase. Mailbox is northeast/right of the porch, shipping bin farther right. The lower direct-east farm route was debris-blocked. The successful farm-to-town route went north, then east to the fence/sign, south onto a clear dirt path, then east through the paved/rail-crossing area into town. Continuing through town passed storefronts, the saloon, playground, trailer, and eastern riverbank; a clinic tree required going south around it.

Beach route and failures: Willy’s letter promised a gift at the beach, shown southeast/south of town beyond the river. The upper east-west river bridge was crossed, but continuing east past the campsite and 1 Willow Lane ended at fences/rail line. A narrow riverside strip south of that bridge was also a dead end: fence/bush/debris blocked passage; pickaxe and axe clicks, C, and diagonal movement did not clear it. Do not retry these dead ends. The successful route backtracked west of the wooden planter/truck and upper bridge to an open junction, followed the southbound dirt path, aligned east with a separate north-south stone bridge, and crossed south; arrival triggered Willy’s dock event.

Willy event completed: he introduced himself, offered his old fishing rod, and the game explicitly confirmed ‘You received a Bamboo Pole!’ He said his shop was open for supplies and would buy caught fish. The main gift goal is therefore complete. Normal control returned at 12:00 p.m.; subsequent westward movement was intended to return toward the sandy shore.

Active goals: return toward Research Farm by reversing the observed beach route, then continue preparing/watering/planting the remaining 14 parsnip seeds. Fishing can be retested later, but only after learning a confirmed bite cue; no successful catch has occurred. Exact current dock position after the last unobserved westward move and the fishing ripple/bite interpretation remain uncertain.
